create.name: Melina Meza
create.bio:
Melina Meza is a yoga teacher, Ayurveda educator and photographer who has taught since the late 1990s. She came to yoga in 1993 while studying nutrition at Bastyr University, trained with Gary Kraftsow among others, and for many years directed and co-directed the 200- and 500-hour teacher trainings at 8 Limbs Yoga Centers in Seattle. Out of this grew Seasonal Vinyasa, her own approach, which links yoga practice, daily routine and food to the rhythm of the four seasons and the five elements.

Now based in Oakland, California, she teaches weekly gentle and strength-based yoga classes in person and online, sees students for private sessions on seasonal yoga, Ayurvedic routines and mindful eating, and leads small residential retreats that mix yoga with nature, creativity and local culture, from the California coast to Japan. Her online classes appear on Yoga Anytime, YogaUOnline and Gaia. Her books include Seasonal Health and Wellness, a week-by-week guide of simple seasonal practices, and of the Art of Sequencing books for yoga teachers, and she brings her eye as a photographer into her teaching on attention and beauty.

courses.title: Winter Treasure Hunt Retreat: Yoga, Nature, Creativity (Monterey)
courses.description: A small winter retreat at a seaside resort on Monterey Bay, with yoga, creative exercises, time in nature and visits to local galleries. Places are by application through Melina.
courses.price: Single: $2700, $2800 w/airport transfer; Double: $2300, $2400 w/airport transfer

courses.title: Japan: Coastal Calm & Ancient Kyoto
courses.description: A week in Kansai with Melina and Baxter Bell, beginning with daily yoga on Awaji Island and continuing to Kyoto for Zen temples, tea and traditional arts.
courses.price: $6,199 per person (double occupancy); $7,699 per person (single occupancy)

courses.title: Weekly Yoga Classes (in person and livestream)
courses.description: Her regular weekly timetable on Pacific time: gentle yoga, yoga with weights, a conditioning class and a Saturday class for students over fifty, with an on-demand library. Some classes are hybrid from a studio in Oakland.

courses.title: Private Sessions: Seasonal Yoga and Ayurveda
courses.description: One-to-one or small-group sessions shaping a seasonal yoga sequence and Ayurvedic daily routine for the student, or bringing mindfulness to eating.
